results.title: Magic Mushrooms
results.overview: Haunted by childhood loss, a quiet young man from rural Idukki finds love with an introverted woman he meets by chance. When prejudice and misunderstanding threaten to separate them, a heartfelt public confession turns resistance into acceptance and leads them toward a hopeful future.

results.title: Love, Rendered
results.overview: Follows an octogenarian couple: Burt is losing his memory; his loving wife Ethelle wants him to retain their most meaningful memories together.

results.title: Onobiren
results.overview: ‘Onobiren: A Woman’s Story,’ follows Roli, a young woman who arrives in Lagos from Warri under the shadow of tradition and expectation. What begins as a familiar narrative quickly transforms when she chooses a different path, one driven by purpose, survival, and self-discovery.

results.title: Marvelous Mio 10th Anniversary
results.original_title: Marvelous桃野美桜デビュー10周年記念！
results.overview: Mio 10th Anniversary was a professional wrestling event promoted by Marvelous That's Women Pro Wrestling, commemorating the tenth anniversary of company star Mio Momono's in-ring debut. It took place on February 13, 2026, at Shin-Kiba 1st RING in Tokyo, Japan.

results.title: Yanuni
results.overview: Indigenous chief Juma Xipaia fights to protect tribal lands despite assassination attempts. Her struggle intensifies after learning she's pregnant, while her husband, Special Forces ranger Hugo Loss, stands by her side.

results.title: DIVINE BURDEN
results.overview: After a young man confesses to taking the lives of his parents in the name of the lord to bring them to god faster, a priest wrestles with the weight of this sin while the killer plans his next attack.

results.title: Last Stop for the Circular Ticket
results.original_title: Dernier Arrêt pour le Billet Circulaire
results.overview: Around Lake Como, a voyage interrupted by a series of brief, successive stops, as fleeting as musical phrases. Someone enters and leaves a telephone booth. Water and the lines that contain it.

results.title: Matininó
results.overview: A multi-generational family of outspoken Puerto Rican women takes center stage as they conceive and perform fantastical film vignettes as a way to navigate painful pasts in this visually-arresting, kaleidoscopic documentary.

results.title: To the Moon and Back
results.overview: Two families from different social strata happen to be neighbors in a hotel in Sri Lanka. Adults are not very happy about this coincidence. But their twenty-year-old "children" fell in love with each other. In order to spend less time with annoying dads and moms, young people embark on their romantic journey through an exotic country, losing track of time. Fathers of families, concerned about this development, set off in search of their adult children, but suddenly they themselves are captured by the aborigines.

results.title: 1936: The Popular Front, Between Joy and Anger
results.original_title: 1936, le Front Populaire, entre joie et colères
results.overview: This brief period in French history (1934–1938), known as the “Popular Front,” has left an indelible mark on the nation's collective memory. Set against the backdrop of a polarized and divided France, this film chronicles a social and cultural revolution, traveling back in time to uncover the places, testimonies, and hidden archives of this formative experience that permanently transformed French society.

results.title: Transferatu
results.overview: Viktor and his young female companion Luna have been living in Berlin for over 100 years. They are junkies, kept going by drugs, blood, and art. They have no fixed sexual orientation, living without sexual intercourse. Young male drug dealers are their primary victims, who end up dying as they orgasm. Klaus is their manager and chauffeur, constantly at their beck and call. He utilizes the dead bodies, selling them for transplant purposes. He loves old American films about exploitation, personally embodying their characters. When Vlad, Viktor’s father, disinherits his son due to his drug addiction, their excesses escalate. Viktor becomes captivated by Mandy, a trans woman. Luna joins them, and in a sensual frenzy, they merge with Mandy until dawn breaks.

results.title: Tenor: My Name Is Pati
results.overview: This music-packed documentary tells the story of Pene Pati and his brother Amitai Pati, and their against-the-odds journey from Samoa to platinum-selling success in the trio Sol3 Mio and on to the world’s greatest opera stages. Bursting with humour, heart and soaring performances, the film reveals the resilience born of adversity, the richness of family and culture, and the rewards that come from following an unlikely dream.

results.title: Home from the Vietnam War
results.overview: Haunted by nightmares, a decorated U.S. veteran returns to Vietnam with a friend who fled the war as a child. Fifty-seven years later, they journey to one of the war's bloodiest battle sites, confronting the soldiers they once fought and long-buried memories in a powerful search for healing and reconciliation.

results.title: My CEO Thinks I’m a Robot
results.original_title: My CEO Thinks I’m a Robot
results.overview: Angela Muji teams up with acclaimed actor Carlo Aquino in a quirky rom-com where an AI developer pretends to be a robot for her longtime crush and CEO. Expect kilig, chaos, and a surprising chemistry you won't see coming.

results.title: Malevolent
results.overview: A construction worker, arrives at a house he is assigned to demolish, only to have the place reopen the shadows of his past.

results.title: Nitassinan
results.overview: Nitassinan is a feature-length documentary that bears witness to the Innu people and affirms our history—past, present, and future. The film testifies to our vitality, our resilience, and the unbreakable bond that unites us to the land. Because Nitassinan is not only the place we come from; it is a living part of ourselves. It has nourished our language, inspired our thoughts, and guided our steps. This film is a message of love for our territory, which saw our birth and which still accompanies us today, even in our dreams.

results.title: TIRESIAS
results.overview: After Jan recovers his vision through experimental back-alley surgery, he begins to uncover a reptilian conspiracy that may involve his doctor, Cleopatra.

results.title: Crocodile
results.overview: In Nigeria, the young art-collective The Critics, armed with makeshift gear, conjures homemade sci-fi spectacles, chronicling their reality while blasting into wild imagined worlds.
